map.由介质折射率与最大接受半角，按 NA = n·sinθ 计算数值孔径。: Computes the numerical aperture as NA = n x sin(theta) from the refractive index of the medium and the maximum acceptance half-angle.
map.填写「介质折射率 n」。: Enter the refractive index of the medium n.
map.填写「最大接受半角 θ (°)」。: Enter the maximum acceptance half-angle theta (degrees).
map.由介质折射率与半孔径角算 NA=n·sinθ。: NA = n x sin(theta) from the refractive index of the medium and the half acceptance angle.
map.NA 决定集光与分辨率。: NA determines light gathering and resolution.
map.油镜提 NA 增分辨。: An oil lens raises NA and resolution.
map.：空气 n=1.0、θ=60° → NA=0.866；浸油 n=1.515、θ=: Air with n=1.0 at theta=60 degrees -> NA=0.866; immersion oil with n=1.515 at theta=60 degrees -> NA=1.31, so light gathering and resolution improve together.
map.：NA 越大瑞利极限 d=0.61λ/NA 越小，λ=550nm、NA=1.31: The larger the NA, the smaller the Rayleigh limit d = 0.61 lambda/NA; with lambda=550 nm and NA=1.31, d is about 256 nm, finer than a dry lens.

map.能。浸油（n>1）使 NA>1，干镜 NA 上限≈1（空气中 sinθ≤1）。: Yes. Immersion oil (n>1) makes NA>1, while a dry lens is capped at about NA 1 (in air sin(theta) is at most 1).
map.NA 大分辨高但景深浅，高倍油镜极薄焦深，需精细调焦。: A large NA gives high resolution but shallow depth of field, so a high-power oil lens has an extremely thin focal depth and needs fine focusing.
